YIF1B -related neurodevelopmental disorder ( YIF1B -NDD) is characterized by severe-to-profound developmental delay / intellectual disability with variable motor abnormalities including axial hypotonia, peripheral hypertonia, dystonia, and dyskinesia; absence of speech in most individuals or very limited speech subject to regression; feeding difficulties; seizures; postnatal microcephaly with nonspecific brain MRI abnormalities; and ophthalmologic involvement (strabismus, nystagmus, optic atrophy, and cortical blindness).
